source_basis.canonical_relation_policy: Evidence-only comparison; no dependence, direction, shared identity, chronology, history, fulfillment, doctrine, canon hierarchy, or boundary authority.

hebrew_english_versification_guard.mapping_note: Received English Mal.4.1-4.6 corresponds to the closing six verses numbered within Hebrew chapter 3 in the Hebrew versification tradition.
hebrew_english_versification_guard.disposition: No silent renumbering, preferred witness, or versification boundary authority.

macro_parents.title: Priestly honor, offerings, and instruction disputation
Harsh words, remembrance, distinction, and day

units.title: Burden and word heading
units.deciding_marker: The burden formula names the word and addressee before direct speech begins at 1:2.
units.rejected_alternative: Attaching the heading to the first disputation is plausible; retain 1:1-5 as the larger alternative.
units.defensible_basis: Heading syntax and direct-speech shift are visible form markers.

units.title: Love challenged, Edom answers, and seeing confession
units.deciding_marker: I-have-loved, How-loved, brother comparison, Edom counter-speech, rebuttal, and your-eyes-will-see close form one exchange.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 1:2-3 as an election proof text or detach Edom and the seeing close.
units.defensible_basis: Alternating speech, question, comparison, counterclaim, rebuttal, and outcome bind the unit.

units.title: Priests, dishonored name, offerings, and Levi contrast
units.deciding_marker: Father/master questions address priests; How-despised and How-polluted lead through offerings to the priestly command, Levi portrait, and contempt conclusion.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not let the English chapter edge sever command and Levi explanation or atomize offering lists.
units.defensible_basis: Name, honor, offering, priest, command, covenant, instruction, path, and stumbling sustain one movement.

units.title: One father, treachery, altar tears, and wife-of-covenant explanation
units.deciding_marker: Father/creator questions open treachery; altar tears lead to Why, witness-wife-covenant explanation, and repeated guard-your-spirit close.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate marriage, offspring, divorce, violence, or foreign-god wording into doctrine fragments.
units.defensible_basis: Treachery repetition, altar scene, Why exchange, covenant/witness vocabulary, and doubled admonition cohere.

units.title: Wearied words, justice question, messenger, refining, and swift witness
units.deciding_marker: How-wearied and Where-is-justice are answered by messenger, coming, endurance questions, refining, restored offerings, and I-will-come-near.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not obey the chapter edge, isolate 3:1 as identity/fulfillment, or detach 3:5 from the justice answer.
units.defensible_basis: The 2:17 problem is answered by 3:1-5 across the chapter edge.

units.title: Return question, robbery question, tithe test, and land outcome
units.deciding_marker: I-do-not-change grounds return; How-return leads to robbery, How-robbed, tithes/offerings, command, test, agricultural outcome, and nations' speech.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 3:8-12 into a tithing/prosperity doctrine.
units.defensible_basis: Return, two audience questions, answer, imperative, test, outcomes, and closing speech form one disputation.

units.title: Harsh speech, fearers' remembrance, discernment, and coming day
units.deciding_marker: Harsh-words and What-spoken lead to complaint; then-fearers spoke shifts to remembrance, possession, discernment, and for-behold-day consequence.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the book, possession, distinction, furnace, sun, healing, or treading into proof texts.
units.defensible_basis: The complaint is answered by the fearers' scene and day outcome; versification cannot override discourse.

units.title: Remember Moses, behold Elijah, and heart-turning close
units.deciding_marker: Remember names Moses/Horeb; behold-send announces Elijah-before-day, heart-turning purpose, and lest-curse warning.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split Moses from Elijah as competing authorities or isolate Elijah as identity/fulfillment.
units.defensible_basis: Parallel imperatives, instruction/prophet frames, before-day clause, purpose, and final warning create closure.

hot_zones.control: Keep claim, objection, comparison, counter-speech, rebuttal, and seeing confession together.
Keep questions, treachery, altar tears, Why exchange, explanation, and guard-your-spirit close together.
Preserve the cross-chapter justice-question and messenger/refiner/swift-witness answer.
Keep fearers, remembrance, possession, and discernment as the response leading into 4:1-3.
Keep 4:1-3 as disputation outcome and 4:4-6 as one closing appeal; no silent renumbering.

appeals.rationale: The heading is a threshold but can travel with the first oracle.
The priestly command restarts at 2:1 while name, offerings, curse, priests, and Levi continue one disputation.
The address widens from priests to communal questions, yet covenant and faithlessness continue.
A fresh wearied-words accusation begins, while faithlessness and justice remain adjacent.
The English chapter edge separates question and answer; the cross-chapter parent remains LOW.
Restored offering shifts to swift witness, but both answer the justice challenge.
I-do-not-change grounds return but may also conclude the preceding answer.
How-return and How-robbed are nested exchanges, but robbery/tithe answers return.
A fresh harsh-words accusation opens, though blessing and proud-prosperity complaint continue thematically.
Narration shifts to fearers, but their scene answers the quoted complaint.
The English edge and for-behold permit a seam, while the day supplies the distinction's outcome.
Remember begins closure, though the Moses-Elijah appeal can conclude the prior disputation.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Mal.1.2-3 becomes an election, ethnicity, ancestry, or predestination proof text.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Keep 1:2-5 whole; Genesis, Deuteronomy, and Romans are evidence only.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Offerings, defects, incense, curse, priests, Levi, or law become isolated ritual/clergy chunks.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Retain Mal.1.6-2.9 with exact internal alternatives.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Mal.2.10-16 becomes settled divorce doctrine, marriage policy, gender system, or violence authorization.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Preserve the question/Why/explanation/refrain parent; defer syntax, reading, application, and doctrine.

major_premortem_failures.failure: The English chapter edge separates Mal.2.17 from Mal.3.1-5.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Use the cross-chapter parent and record the split only as appeal.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Messenger, Lord, covenant messenger, temple, refiner, Levi, or witness gets a fixed identity/fulfillment.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Retain role terms, full answer, later-reuse guards, and LOW/deferred status.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Mal.3.8-12 becomes a universal tithing/prosperity transaction.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Keep it within Mal.3.6-12; Torah context is not doctrine or contemporary application.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Mal.3.16-18 becomes remembrance-book, election, salvation, or afterlife doctrine.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Keep the scene as response leading into Mal.4.1-3 and decide no identity.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Mal.4.1-3 becomes a harmonized judgment timeline or violence ethic.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Keep it as disputation outcome; prohibit chronology, event identity, and fulfillment.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Mal.4.5-6 settles Elijah identity, reincarnation, fulfillment, or Gospel direction.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Keep 4:4-6 whole; later reuse cannot dictate the seam.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Hebrew-English versification creates a false seam or silent renumbering at 3:18|4:1.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Haggai/Zechariah or Former-Prophets parallels become shared history, chronology, identity, or dependence.
